svg.title: RTPS: a 20-byte header, then submessages
svg.desc: The RTPS message of frame 9 of talker-listener-rtps.pcapng, 32 bits per row: the magic RTPS, protocol version 2.1, vendorId 0x0110 (Cyclone DDS) and the 12-byte guidPrefix, then four submessages each introduced by its id, its flags and octetsToNextHeader in the byte order the E flag announces: INFO_DST (12 bytes), INFO_TS (8), DATA (48) and HEARTBEAT (28); RtpsMessage keeps the RtpsHeader and a Vec of RtpsSubmessage with their typed details.
